description: Puntos de recarga eléctrica para vehículos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Alcobendas. City Council of Alcobendas. Location of recharging points for electric vehicles. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Alcobendas. The portal shows the English title as "Electric recharging points for vehicles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Alcobendas. Its keywords include medioambiente, transporte, movilidad, vehículos. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, MS-EXCEL. The listing shows 2023-04-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/odc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
